# Security assessment

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

A check of a system that already runs against a security standard. The OWASP Application Security Verification Standard gives the requirements that an assessment verifies. The OWASP Web Security Testing Guide is a resource for testing the security of web applications.
